title: MonacoCodeEditor
description: A labelled Monaco editor running on a local engine (never a CDN) that follows the page theme. If the engine cannot load or mount in time, it degrades to an editable textarea with a retry button. Import it from @minerva/lib-core/monaco; @monaco-editor/react and monaco-editor are optional peer dependencies.

basic.title: Lazy-loaded editor
basic.description: The editor and the local engine (with its worker configured by the host) are loaded on demand. Without the engine the textarea fallback is shown.

MonacoCodeEditorProps.monaco: Local Monaco engine (import * as monaco from "monaco-editor"); one per application
MonacoCodeEditorProps.onChange: Called with the new source text
MonacoCodeEditorProps.label: Visible label, also the accessible name of the editor
MonacoCodeEditorProps.height: Height in pixels, clamped to [minHeight, maxHeight]
MonacoCodeEditorProps.disabled: Makes the editor (and its fallback) read-only
MonacoCodeEditorProps.theme: Color theme; defaults to the page theme (data-theme on <html>, then ConfigProvider)
MonacoCodeEditorProps.loadTimeout: Milliseconds to wait for the engine before showing the fallback
MonacoCodeEditorProps.unavailableText: Message shown above the fallback textarea
MonacoCodeEditorProps.retryLabel: Accessible label of the retry button
MonacoCodeEditorProps.loadingLabel: Accessible label of the loading indicator
